name: RadioGroup
description: A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once. RadioGroup holds the label and state; each Radio is one option.
whenToUse: To choose one option from two to six that people should compare side by side.
When the options need a short description each.

whenNotToUse.text: For more than about six options.
To turn one setting on or off.
When several options can be chosen.
To switch between views of content.

anatomy.name: Group label
anatomy.description: Names the choice, e.g. "Time period"; announced with the group.

anatomy.name: Control
anatomy.description: Circle that fills with the brand accent when selected.

anatomy.name: Option label
anatomy.description: Names the option; clicking it selects the option.

values.meaning: Options stacked. Default; easiest to scan.
Two or three short options in a row, e.g. Yes / No.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: Shows the option responds to the pointer.

states.name: Disabled
states.meaning: The option or group cannot be changed.
states.trigger: disabled on a Radio or the group.

states.name: Error
states.meaning: The choice is missing or invalid.

behavior.text: The group is one Tab stop. Arrow keys move the selection between options, skipping disabled ones.
Preselect the safest or most common option when there is one; leave all unselected when people must decide.
With a name, the selected value submits in native forms; required prevents submitting without a choice.
Controls sit on the right of their labels in Arabic.

content: Label the group with a noun or question: "Time period", "How should we contact you?".
Keep option labels short, parallel and mutually exclusive.
Order options logically: by size, time or likelihood, not alphabetically by default.

guidelines.do: Use a radio group when people must choose exactly one option.
guidelines.dont: Use radios for independent on/off settings.
guidelines.why: Radios are exclusive; independent settings belong in switches or checkboxes.

guidelines.dont: Rely on a nearby heading that isn’t connected to the group.
guidelines.why: Screen readers announce the group label before the options, giving them context.

guidelines.do: Keep to six options or fewer.
guidelines.dont: List a long set of options as radios.
guidelines.why: Long lists are hard to scan; a Select saves space and keeps the choice clear.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group (to the selected option) and out.
Move to the next or previous option and select it.

aria.when: Links the group to its visible label.
Links the group description and error message.
Set when the group has an error.
Set on each radio from the selection.

accessibility.focus: Focus lands on the selected option (or the first) and shows the focus ring.

wcag.how: Group, option labels and descriptions are programmatically linked.
Unselected controls have a 3:1 boundary; the selected fill and dot keep 3:1.
Arrow keys and Space, one Tab stop per group.
The error text is shown and announced with the group.
Exposed as a radio group with named radios and their checked state.

notes: The error is shown as text, not only as a red border.

examples.title: Choose one
examples.description: A controlled radio group with a label.
examples.code:
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from '@ds/react';

<RadioGroup label="Time period" value={period} onValueChange={setPeriod}>
  <Radio value="today" label="Today" />
  <Radio value="week" label="This week" />
  <Radio value="month" label="This month" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: Options with descriptions
examples.code:
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from '@ds/react';

<RadioGroup label="Plan" defaultValue="pro">
  <Radio value="free" label="Free" description="1 project, community support" />
  <Radio value="pro" label="Pro" description="Unlimited projects, email support" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: Required with an error
examples.description: Show what’s wrong when the choice is missing.
examples.code:
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from '@ds/react';

<RadioGroup label="Delivery" required error="Choose a delivery option.">
  <Radio value="standard" label="Standard" />
  <Radio value="express" label="Express" />
</RadioGroup>

related.relation: Use for longer lists of options.
Use for a single on/off setting.
Use when several options can be chosen.

changes: Replaces RadioButton: RadioGroup and Radio with a group label, descriptions, error state, arrow-key navigation and RTL.
Unselected controls now have a 3:1 boundary.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description:
A set of options where exactly one can be chosen. Arrow keys move between options; the
group is a single Tab stop.

label.description: Visible group label, e.g. "Time period". Without it, pass aria-label.

description.description: Extra detail under the group label.

error.description: Error message. Marks the group invalid and is announced with it.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when the selection changes.

orientation.description: `vertical` (default) stacks options; `horizontal` puts two or three short options in a row.

label.description: Visible option label; clicking it selects the option.
